criteria.text: Identifies that 15% of 16,000,000 Firm Shares is 2,400,000 shares, not the 3,200,000 stated in the Over-allotment Option (Clause 4).
Identifies the inconsistency between 45,200,000 shares in issue in the Prospectus and 46,450,000 in the Underwriting Agreement recital, which must be reconciled before pricing.
Identifies that the comfort letter cut-off of 1 July 2027 is 12 days before the 13 July 2027 pricing date, outside the 3-business-day requirement in Clause 7(b), so a bring-down letter is needed.
Identifies that the Use of Proceeds allocations sum to $125,000,000, not the stated net proceeds of $120,000,000 (a $5,000,000 overstatement).
Flags the share-count inconsistency between the Prospectus and the Underwriting Agreement.
Shows the over-allotment arithmetic (15% x 16,000,000 = 2,400,000) and flags the discrepancy.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
